text:
Lee (Sales): Quick handoff for Orbit — high-level: they signed last week for Redwood Hosted with gradual move to Dedicated in Q3. Main asks: SSO (Okta), HIPAA data contract, and ability to burst capacity for monthly spikes. Renewal window: 11 months from now, likely enterprise conversation.
Priya (CS): Thanks Lee — adding context + risks. Are there any immediate blockers for the initial activation?
Lee (Sales): No infra blockers; legal is finalizing the BAAs today. Risk = SSO mapping: their Okta team uses SCIM for groups and they want role-based routing by group. Sales confirmed API keys and basic provisioning, but not SCIM.
Ravi (Solutions): Pinged their IdP lead yesterday — they said SCIM is on their roadmap but 2–3 weeks out. We should plan a short-term manual group mapping.
Priya (CS): Ok. Action for CS: implement manual role mapping during onboarding and schedule SCIM rollout once customer's IdP is ready. Owner: Priya.
Jon (Support): From support side — potential eng escalation: if we need automated SCIM we may need integration work. Mei, can you estimate effort for a scoped SCIM connector?
Mei (Engineering): Quick gut check: for SCIM provisioning + group sync to our RBAC we’re looking at ~3–5 dev days + QA, assuming standard Okta flows. If there are custom attributes it could go longer.
Priya (CS): Noted. For now we'll do manual mapping and log the SCIM work as an engineering request.
Lee (Sales): Also note they want a private dataset sync to a VPC in Q3. That will bump the contract. Legal + sales already flagged it.
Priya (CS): OK. Onboarding checklist (short): 1) Provision sandbox API keys (Ravi) 2) Manual role mapping + onboarding doc (Priya) 3) SSO test with Okta (customer + Ravi) 4) Observe first-week usage & latency (Support) 5) Ticket SCIM integration if IdP ready (Mei)
Ravi (Solutions): I created the sandbox workspace and dropped creds into the secure vault. Link: https://vault.internal/secret/xyZ (customer only).
ops-bot: Reminder: created onboarding-ticket #CS-2987 for Orbit activation.
Priya (CS): Assigning owners in thread: Ravi — sandbox & Okta test setup; Priya — onboarding doc & manual mapping; Jon — monitor first-week telemetry and escalate any e2e latency/regression to eng; Mei — scope SCIM work and give implementation ETA if requested.
Jon (Support): I'll add SLO/alert checks for token error spikes and 95th pct latency > 700ms. If we hit that, I'll route to eng oncall.
Mei (Engineering): Understood. If Jon triggers escalation please include request payload samples and KV cache usage patterns — that helps triage fast.
Lee (Sales): Renewal signal: procurement asked about committed burst capacity and dedicated SLA by month 8. That’s our leverage but also a risk if they push discounts early. Priya — can you capture renewal concerns in the account health doc?
Priya (CS): Will do. I'll add a renewal-risk section with the commercial ask (burst SLA), legal sign-offs, and recommended next steps: (a) enable trial dedicated pool for month 6 spike proof, (b) schedule exec check-in at month 9.
Ravi (Solutions): One more ask: they requested a sample prompt bundle to validate hallucination rates vs their risk tolerance. I'll attach our standard eval set and collect feedback.
Priya (CS): Great — add findings to CS feedback tracker and share with product if we see quality regressions.
Lee (Sales): Final: intro call with customer success is tomorrow 10am PT. Priya, you'll lead. Customer contact: emma@orbithealth.com.
Priya (CS): I'll run the call and capture notes. I'll post the onboarding doc + next-step ticket after the meeting.
Jon (Support): Ack. I'll standby to enable observability dashboards and add the alerts.
Mei (Engineering): I'll leave a placeholder in our backlog: SCIM connector for Orbit (link: https://tracker.internal/SCIM-247). If they bump the timeline, we can re-prioritize.
Lee (Sales): Thanks everyone. Tagging @Priya for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
